source_snapshot.items: Flash BIOS via AMI tool - upgrade

source_snapshot.criteria: BIOS flash succeeds and the post-flash BIOS version is correct.
source_snapshot.script: Private afuefi_upgrade path; 10 attended and 30 machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; correctly requires an AMI tool, user-designated image, interruption-free flash, power transition and version check, but lacks identity, provenance, compatibility, recovery and full post-flash health.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION at HIGH risk; validates board/image/tool and recovery, preserves baseline, uses only the documented switches, supervises AC/reboot and verifies BIOS/ME/TPM/boot/device health.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Directionally correct on state change and image ownership, insufficient to prevent a compatible-looking wrong image, unsupported AMI utility or successful exit with an unbootable system.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds signed image provenance, platform matching, stable power, recovery readiness and broad post-activation validation while preserving the exact source command.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code searches found no duplicate; row 1537 was read only as the distinct downgrade operation.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Firmware writes and power transitions require explicit approval, exact identity and recovery; a missing supplied image/tool is conditional readiness rather than a reason to guess or execute.

original_test_intent: Upgrade the verified SUT BIOS to the exact approved newer release using the supported AMI EFI tool and component switches, activate it through the required AC transition and confirm the intended firmware plus system health.
original_method: Bind the board and current/target BIOS/ME state, verify the signed image and AMI utility, preserve configuration and logs, execute the exact source command once under uninterrupted power, perform the owner-approved AC cycle, then prove boot, versions, configuration, TPM and device health.
manual_activity: The firmware owner selects and authorizes the exact image and component scope; an operator verifies stable power, supervises the irreversible flash window and AC transition, and controls any recovery action.
required_inputs: Exact SUT board PN/SKU/revision, CPU family and current BIOS/ME/firmware inventory
Approved target BIOS release, release notes, compatibility matrix, checksum and signature
Vendor-supported afuefix64.efi version and EFI environment
Meaning and approval of `/P /B /N /ME` for this platform
Saved BIOS configuration, boot/secure-boot/TPM state and expected migration behavior
Stable power/UPS, AC-cycle timing, console/OOB and verified recovery image/procedure
safety_requirements: Preserve the full pre-flash version, configuration, TPM, boot, device and event baseline before any clear
Reject any board/image/tool/signature/compatibility mismatch before execution
Do not add undocumented switches, change image or retry during the approved run
Maintain uninterrupted power and do not reset or AC-cycle until the AMI tool reaches its documented completion state
Stop further writes on flash error, verification failure or unexpected output
Perform only the approved post-flash AC transition and never blind-cycle after boot failure
Use the verified recovery path under firmware-owner control
agent_execution_scope: Read and validate platform identities, image/tool hashes, signatures and release compatibility
Stage but do not execute the exact command before approval
Capture immutable pre-flash evidence and verify recovery/power readiness
After approval, run the documented AMI command once and retain complete output/status
Observe the authorized AC/boot lifecycle and collect post-flash versions/configuration/TPM/device/events
Report comparison and anomalies without retry or final verdict
engineer_actions: Approve target image, component switches, expected migrations and recovery
Confirm stable power and supervise flash plus AC transition
Decide and perform recovery if activation fails
Review complete pre/post evidence and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its staged AMI upgrade direction fits, but `dmidecode -s bios-version` alone cannot prove image/platform compatibility, ME/component update, preserved boot/TPM/device state or successful activation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Execute only `afuefix64.efi <approved-image> /P /B /N /ME` in the verified supported EFI environment after explicit approval; preserve complete output and do not infer success before the post-AC lifecycle and health comparison.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Upgrade intent, exact `/P /B /N /ME` switches, required AC transition, version check, private script reference and 10/30-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Verify board/image/tool compatibility and recovery, archive baseline, flash once under stable power, activate via the prescribed AC transition and validate every affected firmware and platform state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds cryptographic provenance, exact platform/component scope, configuration preservation, recovery and full post-activation health beyond a version string.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful tool exit or OS-reported BIOS version without AC activation and platform-health checks is incomplete upgrade coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Updating BIOS plus boot block/NVRAM/ME scopes can brick the board, reset settings or affect TPM, secure boot and device initialization if interrupted or incompatible.

project_override_considerations: If the vendor package prescribes different switches or activation behavior, Project SPEC must approve the package-native procedure and document why each original `/P /B /N /ME` scope is covered or intentionally omitted; no switch is silently changed.
expected_evidence: Board/current BIOS/ME/firmware identity, target release/compatibility and image checksum/signature
AMI tool version/hash, EFI environment, approved exact command and stable-power/recovery readiness
Complete pre-flash BIOS configuration, boot/secure-boot/TPM/device and BMC/OS event baseline
Full AMI stdout/stderr/status and uninterrupted-flash/finish timestamps
Authorized AC transition, boot milestones and post-flash BIOS/ME/firmware versions
Post-state configuration/TPM/boot/device/event comparison, any recovery and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, AMI command, activation step and Criteria consistently define a BIOS upgrade. Missing image, tool version and compatibility/recovery details are required execution inputs, not conflicting operations.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The exact image, platform mapping, AMI tool and recovery are finite firmware-owner inputs. Until supplied, the flash is not executable, but the intended upgrade and acceptance remain clear.

review_improvement: Expands DeepSeek's correct high-level boundary into an exact image/tool/component, stable-power, activation and recovery contract and prevents a version-only check from masking configuration or device regressions.
independent_technical_reasoning: Firmware flash completion and firmware activation are separate states. Because the command writes multiple regions, a new BIOS version after AC does not prove that boot block, NVRAM, ME, security state and devices are coherent; the preserved baseline and post-activation matrix are necessary to distinguish a successful upgrade from a partially functional one.
